verdict.rationale: Dropbox's AI features let users interact in natural language for some tasks: Dash answers questions across team knowledge, and Dropbox advertises AI summarization, document review and file organization, plus integrations with leading AI tools. Nothing shows natural-language commands actually operating the product, such as moving, sharing, deleting or configuring files. The AI homepage line ("AI is coming to Dropbox") also reads as forward-looking, and the evidence is mostly marketing titles. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core file and sharing operations, detailed docs on a command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration, and confirmation the AI features are generally available.
